name: holder-rewards
description: Self-hostable Discord NFT/token holder verification and rewards platform.

scripts.check:cloudflare-release: node scripts/sync-cloudflare-release.mjs --check && pnpm --dir cloudflare install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && node scripts/test-cloudflare-deploy.mjs && pnpm --dir cloudflare typecheck && pnpm --dir cloudflare build
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @holder-rewards/chains build && pnpm db:migrate:cloudflare && wrangler deploy

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Discord bot token from the Bot page in the Discord Developer Portal. Treat this like a password.
